tower-of-hanoi.title: Goal Stack Ordering
tower-of-hanoi.principle: The final configuration on any peg must be a descending stack: larger disks at the bottom and smaller disks on top.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: After constructing a move sequence, verify that each peg in the goal state has disks in strictly decreasing size from bottom to top.
tower-of-hanoi.example: If the goal is all disks on peg 2, the stack must read [5,4,3,2,1] from bottom to top.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Free Blocked Disk
tower-of-hanoi.principle: A disk that has any smaller disks stacked above it cannot be moved; those smaller disks must be relocated first.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Before attempting to move a disk, check whether it is the topmost disk on its peg.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Disk 4 on peg 0 cannot be moved while disk 1 sits on top of it; move disk 1 elsewhere first.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Use Auxiliary Peg for Temporary Storage
tower-of-hanoi.principle: In a three‑peg problem, the peg that is neither the source nor the destination can be used as a temporary holding place for disks.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Whenever a direct move would violate ordering, move the blocking disk to the third peg before proceeding.
tower-of-hanoi.example: To move disk 5 from peg 0 to peg 2 while peg 1 is empty, use peg 1 to store smaller disks temporarily.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Check Move Legality
tower-of-hanoi.principle: A legal move must take the topmost disk from the source peg and place it onto a destination peg whose top disk is larger (or the peg is empty).
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: For every proposed move, verify both the source‑top condition and the destination‑top condition.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Moving disk 3 onto a peg whose top is disk 2 is illegal because 3 > 2.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Simulate Final Configuration
tower-of-hanoi.principle: After constructing a move list, mentally replay each move from the initial state to ensure every move is legal and the final state matches the goal.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Before submitting the answer, run through the entire sequence step‑by‑step and compare the resulting configuration with the goal.
tower-of-hanoi.example: After the last move, confirm that peg 2 contains [5,4,3,2,1] and pegs 0 and 1 are empty.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Maintain 0‑Indexed Peg Numbers
tower-of-hanoi.principle: The output format expects peg identifiers 0, 1, 2; using any other numbering (e.g., 1‑based) will cause parsing errors.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: When writing each move, always refer to pegs by 0, 1, 2.
tower-of-hanoi.example: The move “move disk 1 from peg 0 to peg 2” is encoded as [1,0,2].

tower-of-hanoi.title: Track Current Top Disk on Each Peg
tower-of-hanoi.principle: Keep an up‑to‑date record of the topmost disk on every peg after each move, so you know which disks are movable.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Update the top‑disk record immediately after each move and consult it before planning the next move.
tower-of-hanoi.example: After moving disk 1 from peg 0 to peg 1, the top of peg 0 becomes disk 4.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Leverage Existing Larger Disks on Target as Base
tower-of-hanoi.principle: If the destination peg already contains larger disks that are correctly placed, you can place a smaller disk onto them without disturbing the existing order.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: When the target peg’s top disk is larger than the moving disk, move the smaller disk directly onto the target.
tower-of-hanoi.example: With peg 2 containing disk 5 at the bottom, moving disk 4 onto peg 2 is legal because 5 > 4.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Clear Destination Peg of Smaller Top Disk Before Placing Larger Disk
tower-of-hanoi.principle: If the destination peg’s top disk is smaller than the disk you intend to move, you must first relocate that smaller top disk elsewhere.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Before moving a larger disk onto a peg, check the peg’s top; if it’s smaller, move that top disk to the auxiliary peg first.
tower-of-hanoi.example: To move disk 5 onto peg 2 while disk 2 sits on top, first move disk 2 to another peg.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Use Smallest Disk as Flexible Buffer
tower-of-hanoi.principle: The smallest disk can be placed on any peg without violating ordering, making it an ideal temporary buffer.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: When you need a free peg or must free a larger disk, move the smallest disk to the auxiliary peg first.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Move disk 1 to peg 1 to free disk 4 on peg 0.

tower-of-hanoi.description: Placing a larger disk onto a smaller one
tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model may forget the rule that larger disks cannot be placed on smaller ones, especially when focusing on moving a specific larger disk.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Always compare the size of the moving disk with the top disk of the destination; only proceed if the destination is empty or its top is larger.

tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model may overlook that only the topmost disk of a peg can be moved, particularly when a disk is blocked by smaller ones.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Before each move, verify that the chosen disk is currently the topmost on its peg.

tower-of-hanoi.description: Prematurely placing a small disk on the goal peg
tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model may try to complete the goal stack early by placing a small disk before larger ones are in place, violating final ordering.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Reserve placement of the smallest disks for the final steps after all larger disks are correctly positioned.

tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model may default to 1‑based indexing or miscount pegs.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Remember that pegs are numbered 0, 1, 2; double‑check each move’s peg numbers before writing them.

tower-of-hanoi.description: Skipping final verification of the goal state
tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model may assume the constructed sequence is correct without checking the final configuration.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Replay the entire move list from the initial state and confirm that the final configuration exactly matches the goal.
